key_findings.finding: card1=6550 is a highly established entity with 1126 prior transactions and a mature fraud rate of only 0.31%, with 0% fraud on the card1|addr1 pairing (186 priors). This is inconsistent with fraud.
No gang pattern: gang_score is 0.003 and device fan-out is 1, indicating a single-device, non-mule entity. Address/email fan-out (29/14) is proportionate to 1126 legitimate transactions.
Transaction profile is mundane: $261.95, ProductCD=W, visa/debit. Category base rates (ProductCD=W 2.06%, visa 3.46%) are at or below the ~3.5% global base rate.

No risk rules hit. Similar confirmed-fraud cases share only superficial features (ProductCD=W, visa/debit, $100-300 band) but their fraudulent card1s had device fan-out of 5-7; this card1's fan-out=1 plus 1126 clean priors matches the false-positive/clean profile, not the fraud profile.
The GBDT score p=0.0031 is independently corroborated by entity history and category base rates; no conflict between model and evidence.

gang_association.rationale: gang_score 0.003, device fan-out 1, and 0% fraud on the card1|addr1 pairing all indicate a single, established legitimate cardholder rather than a coordinated fraud ring.

report.disposition_rationale: Multiple independent evidence lines (established 1126-txn history with 0.31% mature fraud rate, gang_score 0.003, device fan-out 1, no rules hit, below-baseline category rates) converge on low fraud probability. Similar confirmed-fraud cases are distinguishable by high device fan-out that this entity lacks. Expected fraud loss on a $261.95 transaction at this probability is far below the $25/$5 review costs, so approving is the cost-minimizing action.
report.summary: Transaction 3562477 ($261.95, ProductCD=W, visa/debit) originates from a well-established card (card1=6550) with 1126 prior transactions, a 0.31% mature fraud rate, 0% fraud on its address pairing, gang_score 0.003, and a single associated device. No risk rules were triggered, and category base rates sit at or below the global average. While some superficially similar historical cases were confirmed fraud, those entities exhibited high device fan-out (5-7) that this entity lacks — this profile matches the clean/false-positive pattern. The evidence independently confirms the low GBDT score (p=0.0031). Recommendation: approve.
